story.title: The Forest Party

panels.desc: A party in the glade behind the last door, under strings of little flags. A long table made of black wooden blocks holds a tall stack of pancakes, little plates of snacks and a whisk in a bowl; guests sit around it: the three chipmunks, the Duck King and his ducks, the crab with its drum, the chimp in its vest holding its little lamp, the moth and the fluffy baby bird. Bun points at the table; Hedgie carries a tray; Pip sings on a flag string; Pim and Pam hang a garland together; Beads clicks. Grumble does NOT appear — only his lantern light glows among the trees at the edge of the glade. Hidden in the picture: the flags, the black blocks, the stack, the snack, the lamp, the whisk.
panels.ko: 마지막 문 너머 풀밭에서 숲 파티! 까만 블록 식탁에 팬케이크와 간식. 다람쥐들, 오리 왕, 게, 침팬지, 나방, 아기 새가 손님이에요.

panels.desc: Party games: the chimp swings high on the big wooden swing, the ducks swim in a little pond, and the crab drums. Grumble steps into the glade from the trees with his lantern — walking on the ground now, not up in the treetops — looking shy; everyone turns and waves him over; Pip flies to him; Pim and Pam land together on his nightcap. Hidden in the picture: the swing, the swimming ducks, the pond, the drum, the crab.
panels.ko: 침팬지는 그네를 타고, 오리들은 헤엄치고, 게는 북을 둥둥. 그럼블이 나무 위가 아니라 땅으로 걸어와요. "나도 그네 타도 돼?"

panels.desc: Grumble sits in the middle of the party beating the crab's drum with two sticks, grinning wide, his nightcap bouncing; the crab clacks its claws in time; everyone claps and dances around him. Pip stands on a black block reading out words, beak open; Beads conducts with a string of beads; Pim and Pam sing together. A clock on a tree trunk ticks along; the green tent stands at the edge of the glade. Hidden in the picture: the drum, the sticks, clapping paws, the clock, the tent.
panels.ko: 그럼블이 게의 북을 막대기로 둥둥 쳐요. 모두 손뼉 치며 춤춰요. 핍은 블록 위에서 짝꿍 단어를 읽어요.

panels.desc: Night. The party has gone quiet: everyone stands at the far edge of the forest looking out over a moonlit valley. On a hill far away stands a tall castle with a big gate, and on the gate glows a short word, c a p — and as they watch, a tiny sparkling letter e appears at its end, making cape; these four letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture. Grumble holds up his lantern; Hedgie points with one paw; Pip tilts its head; Pim and Pam huddle wide-eyed; Bun holds the patchwork quilt around her shoulders; Beads's antennae stand straight up; in a nest in a nearby tree the chimp sits with its little lamp, waving one hand. Hidden in the picture: the quilt around Bun, the chimp's lamp, the nest, the chimp's waving hand.
panels.ko: 밤, 숲 끝에서 저 멀리 언덕 위 성이 보여요. 성문에 c·a·p — 그런데 끝에 반짝이는 e 가 붙어 단어가 바뀌어요! "캡이 아니야!"

story.synopsis_ko: 마지막 문 너머 풀밭에서 숲 파티가 열려요. 그럼블이 나무에서 내려와 게의 북을 둥둥, "쉿 아니고 sh, ch, th!" 밤이 되자 숲 끝 저 멀리 성이 보여요. 성문의 단어 cap 끝에 e 가 반짝 붙어 단어가 바뀌어요!
story.so_far_ko: 핍이 혼자 마지막 문을 열고 노래 조각 셋을 찾았어요. 그럼블도 따라 흥얼거렸어요.
story.goal_ko: 파티에서 이어 소리·끝소리·wh·qu 를 복습하고 성문의 수수께끼를 봐요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the raccoon beats the crab's drum with two sticks and his nightcap bounces, the crab clacks its claws in time, the friends and animals clap and dance in a circle under strings of little flags. Camera still. Festive, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation at night: far away on a hill, the glowing letters on a castle gate shimmer and a tiny sparkle appears at their end; the friends at the forest edge lean forward, the raccoon raises his lantern, the twin bluebirds blink wide-eyed. Camera still. Mysterious but friendly, child-friendly. No other text.
